coverage_claim: Bounded extraction pass for issue #245, lane microbial, cutoff 2026-11-15. It covers the Bacformer and BacBench repository READMEs at the pinned commits, the released Hugging Face checkpoints, and the six benchmark tables of version 3 of the preprint. It is not a literature search of bacterial genomic language models, not all-model coverage, and no number was reproduced.
decision: Extraction pass, not a discovery search: the issue supplied the leads and this pass pinned them. Retrieved and pinned 13 artifacts, extracted the 186 printed cells of the six benchmark tables of preprint v3 (S1, S12, S13, S14, S16, S18) and wrote 490 records to data/omics/bacformer-20261115/batch.jsonl (13 sources, 12 models, 26 configurations, 1 benchmark, 6 tasks, 6 datasets, 2 dataset subsets, 17 protocols, 186 evaluations, 186 results, 35 claims). Nothing added to the store; a different agent reviews the batch.
excluded: Supplementary Table S15 (protein function prediction): BacBench does not list the task, so it is outside the benchmark this batch registers.
Supplementary Tables S2, S10, S11 and S17: statistical comparisons, context parameters, GPU-hours and per-drug counts rather than benchmark performance.
Europe PMC full-text XML and supplementary CSVs for PPR1052405: retrieved and hashed, but the XML holds no tables and nothing was computed from the CSVs, so neither is registered as a source.
failed_candidates: bioRxiv JATS source.xml for v2 and v3: HTTP 301 with an empty body; the PDF was used instead.

macwiatrak/bacformer-causal-protein-family-modeling-complete-genomes and macwiatrak/bacformer-for-essential-genes-prediction: HTTP 401 from both the page and the model API, so the two README-listed checkpoints could not be inspected.
https://huggingface.co/datasets/macwiatrak/datasets, the collection URL in the preprint's availability statement: HTTP 401.
The author's LinkedIn announcement named in the issue: not retrieved, not a primary source, and the issue records that commenting is restricted.
gaps: Supplementary Tables S2, S10, S11, S15 and S17 were not extracted.
No figure was read; figure-only numbers are unrecorded, including the Bacformer-only analyses in Figures 1 to 4.
Main-text prose figures for the Bacformer-only analyses were not extracted.
Test-genome counts behind the PPI and essentiality aggregates are not printed, so those denominators are unreported.
Table S16's caption says 5 seeds while the Methods say three independent runs; unresolved in the source.
No split manifest, seed list or BacBench commit is published for any run.
Dataset licences were seen only in Hugging Face card metadata, which was not pinned as a source.
Parameter counts disagree across sources for both Bacformer sizes and are left unresolved for review.
Whether the preprint's Bacformer Large runs postdate the 2025-05-15 embedding bug fix cannot be settled from these sources.
